source.notes: Official site links a ZIP with the matching kit name. The full official archive was not downloaded for byte comparison. No license/terms/README accompanies the supplied directory.

rules: Use the Valkyria crest for clan and bot identity; Wardogs wordmarks only identify the game.
Keep runtime text and live server state separate from artwork. Unknown/stale states must not look online.
No recoloring, distortion, unapproved trademark claims, or invented event/statistics evidence.
Keep source files unchanged. Optimize selected runtime copies in the consuming app without replacing these originals.
